backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing user profiles, categories, vendors, banks, expenses, revenue, and COGS data with authorization and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting report‑related UI updates, affected frontend files, components, and related test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of multiple frontend components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining global styles, OKLCH color variables, and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing root div and script loader for the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app entry configuring TanStack Router, authentication gating, profile setup flow, and all route definitions.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout component providing header navigation, logout handling, main content area, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/KpiCard.tsx: Reusable KPI card displaying a formatted metric with icon and variant‑based color styling.
frontend/src/components/NumericCell.tsx: Table cell component formatting numeric values as currency, percent, or number with right alignment.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog shown to new users allowing them to submit their name and create a user profile.
frontend/src/components/reports/MonthYea: Renders dropdowns for selecting month and year, generating month labels and a 10‑year range around the current year.
frontend/src/components/reports/YearSele: Provides a simple year dropdown selector using a 10‑year range around the current year.
frontend/src/components/TimeWindowSelect: Select component for choosing predefined time windows such as day, month, or multi‑month ranges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, categories with auto‑seeding, and other backend data interactions.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables, theming, utilities, and print styling rules.
frontend/src/lib/constants/paymentMethod: Declares fixed restaurant payment method constants and their TypeScript type.
frontend/src/lib/seed/restaurantCategori: Provides default restaurant category names and seed metadata used for initial category population.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function combining clsx and tailwind‑merge for class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsItemsTab.tsx: Manages inventory items with vendor associations, listing them and enabling CRUD through a dialog form.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsPurchasesTab: UI for listing, adding, and editing COGS purchase records with dialogs and table display.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSalesTab.tsx: UI for listing, adding, and editing COGS sales records with dialogs and table display.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSummaryTab.t: Displays COGS totals and trends over selectable time ranges with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/utils.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates, timestamps, and YearMonthBucket values plus lookup helpers.
frontend/src/pages/CogsPage.tsx: Displays the COGS interface with tabbed navigation for items, purchases, sales, and summary.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the financial dashboard with KPIs, time window selection, and quick stats based on queried data.
frontend/src/pages/ExpensesPage.tsx: Displays a list of expenses with filtering and CRUD via a dialog form, loading data from multiple query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides a login screen using Internet Identity with a simple sign-in button and loading state.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Hosts tabs for managing categories, vendors, banks, and payment methods, each with listing and CRUD dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Generates expense and revenue reports over configurable date ranges with filters and summary data.
frontend/src/pages/RevenuePage.tsx: Shows revenue entries and supports adding and editing them through a dialog-based form.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing features, issues, and versioning for a reporting enhancement.
